# third_party/ (native editor)

Source copies, pinned to a release, each with its licence file next to it. Nothing here is edited; to update one, replace
the folder with the new release and change the line below.

| Folder | Name | Version | Licence | URL | Why |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `qtads/` | Qt Advanced Docking System (`src/`, `cmake/`, top-level `CMakeLists.txt`; demo, examples, docs and the Python bindings are left out) | 5.1.1 | LGPL-2.1 (`qtads/LICENSE`, `qtads/gnu-lgpl-v2.1.md`) | https://github.com/githubuser0xFFFF/Qt-Advanced-Docking-System | dock panels, floating windows, saved layouts. Built as a **shared** library (DLL) next to the exe so the editor can relink against a modified copy (LGPL). 02_BUILD_AND_TOOLING.md named "4.x"; 5.1.1 was the latest release when T0.3 was done and supports Qt 6.8+ |
| `vma/` | Vulkan Memory Allocator (`vk_mem_alloc.h`) | 3.5.0 | MIT (`vma/LICENSE.txt`) | https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/VulkanMemoryAllocator | every buffer / image allocation. Header-only; exactly one `.cpp` defines `VMA_IMPLEMENTATION` |
| `volk/` | volk (`volk.h`, `volk.c`) | tag `vulkan-sdk-1.4.363.0` (header version 363) | MIT (`volk/LICENSE.md`) | https://github.com/zeux/volk | loads Vulkan entry points at run time (no link-time dependency on `vulkan-1.lib`) |

| `streamline/` (not in git: `native/tools/fetch_streamline.ps1` downloads it, SHA-256 pinned) | NVIDIA Streamline SDK | 2.14.16 | NVIDIA RTX SDK licence (`streamline/license.txt`, `3rd-party-licenses.md`); private editor, NVIDIA code may be used and changed (user decision 2026-11-20), own rewrite if the editor is ever published | https://github.com/NVIDIA-RTX/Streamline/releases/tag/v2.14.16 (`streamline-sdk-v2.14.16.zip`, 276 MB) | Reflex + PCL (T6.7), DLSS Super Resolution (T6.8), DLSS Ray Reconstruction (R2). Only `include/` is compiled against; `sl.interposer.dll` and the plugins are loaded at run time and copied next to the exe by CMake. Optional: without it the editor builds and runs without NVIDIA features |

| `sharc/` (headers only: `include/*.h`, `docs/Integration.md`; images dropped) | NVIDIA SHaRC (spatially hashed radiance cache) | 1.8.3 | NVIDIA RTX SDKs licence (`sharc/License.md`; NOT MIT: private editor, same terms as Streamline) | https://github.com/NVIDIA-RTX/Sharc | bounce light of the ray traced Lit path (R6): hash grid + update / resolve / query, used through its GLSL helpers (`shaders/rt_sharc_*.comp`). Downloaded 2026-11-21 with the user's yes |

| `fidelityfx/` (not in git: `native/tools/fetch_fidelityfx.ps1` downloads it, SHA-256 pinned: the API and upscaler headers, the licence and the two signed Vulkan DLLs) | AMD FidelityFX SDK (FidelityFX API, FSR upscaler provider) | 2.4.0 | the headers carry an MIT notice in each file; `fidelityfx/license.md` covers the rest: the signed DLLs may be redistributed in binary form only, with the notice reproduced (no reverse engineering); private editor, the notice travels with the DLLs in this folder | https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/FidelityFX-SDK/releases/tag/v2.4.0 (raw files of the tag, about 36 MB) | FSR, the temporal upscaler for AMD, Intel and every other GPU (T15.1, 11_NVIDIA_TECH.md section 5). Only the headers are compiled against; `amd_fidelityfx_loader_vk.dll` and `amd_fidelityfx_upscaler_vk.dll` are loaded at run time and copied next to the exe by CMake. Optional: without it the editor builds and runs without FSR. Downloaded 2026-11-22 (blanket yes for SDK downloads) |

Vulkan API headers are not here: native code uses the Core's copy (`core/vendored/vulkan`, SDK 1.4.363 headers, T0.2).
